Your WordPress site address, e.g. https:: Your WordPress site address, e.g. https://example.com
\n1. In WordPress, go to **Forms > Setti:
1. In WordPress, go to **Forms > Settings > REST API** and tick **Enabled** under "Enable access to the API".
2. Under **Authentication (API version 2)**, click **Add Key**, pick an administrator user and set **Permissions** to **Read/Write**.
3. Copy the **Consumer Key** and **Consumer Secret**; they are shown only once.
4. **Site URL** is your WordPress home address. It must start with https.

\n- Go to the \"Plugins\" section.\n- Fi:
- Go to the "Plugins" section.
- Find and click on the "Webhook" plugin to activate it.
- Now, locate the form where you want the trigger to occur.
- Add a webhook to that form.
- In the webhook settings, paste this URL: 
  ```text
  {{webhookUrl}}
  ```

- Keep the other settings unchanged (default).
